## Description

**What**: Add an inference-signal scan to plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md Part B with extended trigger word list (hedging + confident assertions) and MUST-execute Read/Grep verification (5-second timeout; reasoning-in-lieu-of-tool-call explicitly prohibited).

**Why**: This is the downstream catch when an inferred input source slips through Phase 1 dialogue. Closes the dialogue-layer Sycophancy bot-psychologist identified in brainstorm.

**Scope**:
- IN: Extended trigger word list (hedging: assume/assumed/likely/probably/presumably/should be/we'll get; confident assertions: from the system/loaded from/provided by/is fetched from/returns/comes from/is stored in/pulls from/reads from/is generated by/is provided via/expect/anticipate/will be supplied); MUST-execute Read/Grep verification with 5-second timeout; on timeout: treat as not-verifiable and fire; explicit prohibition on reasoning from cached context as substitute for tool call.
- OUT: Trigger-word list config extension (YAGNI); concurrent-session handling.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md Part B contains the inference-signal scan section with the documented extended trigger word list and MUST-execute language, verified by structural test on the file's Part B section.
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-file structural consistency"
- When this story is complete, the scan section explicitly prohibits reasoning from cached context as a substitute for the Read/Grep tool call, with treat-as-not-verifiable-and-fire fallback on timeout, verified by structural test asserting the canonical phrases are present.
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-file structural consistency"
- When this story is complete, a synthetic brainstorm where the Understanding Summary's Inputs bullet contains an inferred source (e.g., "translations loaded from the locale system") triggers re-entry to Phase 1 Step 2 with a targeted Socratic question per inferred source, observable via the Phase 1 dialogue transcript.
  ← Satisfies: "Translation replay"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md is also touched by epics 6111-fc7f (execution trace), 1d4f-9feb (relates_to suggestion), d63f-2c74 (operational atomicity); coordinate insertion points in Part B; later-landing epic rebases.
- [Reliability] On slow filesystems, the 5-second timeout must fail closed (treat-as-not-verifiable-and-fire), not open (treat-as-verified-suppress).
- [Testing] Trigger-word list cannot exhaustively cover paraphrasing; rely on the multi-layer defense — assumption category Step 1 (S3) provides the second-line catch via mandatory verification.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a brainstorm user, gap analysis catches inferred input sources via signal scan with mandatory verification
